bugs.summary: automaticKinds checks the hub sender by parsing headers out of message.content, but stock delivers a director the parsed headers on message.headers and only the text part (the request JSON) as content, so isFromTriageSender always returns false and every granted Do kind is dropped: no granted mirror or Do ever runs.
bugs.evidence: directors.ts:153-155 `function automaticKinds(content: string | undefined, ...)` / `if (!isFromTriageSender(content) || ...) return [];`, called at :296 `automatic = automaticKinds(message.content, input);`. isFromTriageSender (packages/triage-contracts/src/trigger-mail.ts:18-24, outside the diff) reads `headers.from`/`headers.to` from the parsed payload. Stock InboundMessage (vendor/interchange/packages/types/src/runtime-core.ts:389-406) carries `headers: MessageHeaders` separately from `content?: string` (plain text body), so the request JSON in content has no headers. Fix #225 changes the signature to take `Pick<InboundMessage, "headers" | "content">` and passes `message` at both call sites; prod evidence in #225: worker received `automatic: ["labels"]` and recorded `[]`.
